use serde_json::Value;

pub fn solve(input: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
    let path = input.as_str().unwrap();
    let mut ancestors = Vec::new();
    let mut current_path = path.to_string();
    while current_path != "/" {
        ancestors.push(current_path);
        current_path = current_path.split('/').next().unwrap_or("/");
    }
    ancestors.reverse();
    ancestors
}
